name: CDT Equipamentos Desportivos, Lda
note: Portuguese sports-kit maker based in Oliveira S. Mateus, Vila Nova de Famalicão; created in 2012 by businessman Bruno Salgado, per a company profile published by the municipality of Vila Nova de Famalicão (famalicaomadein.pt). Kit supplier (technical sponsor) to Moreirense FC: the maker's own site lists Moreirense FC under 'Sponsor' (cdt-equipamentos.com).
